info.name: Items - Inventory Excel Upload
info.description:
# Items inventory Excel upload

Bulk-creates inventory items from the **INVENTORY LIST** workbook (columns A–S) using **chunked `insert_batch`** across physical DBs (avoids gateway 504).

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Form-data (POST): `token`, `requester` (required)

## Flow
1. `GET /items/download_inventory_template` — download encoder template
2. Fill rows starting at **row 3** (rows 1–2 are headers)
3. `POST /items/upload_inventory` with `start_row=3` and `limit=25`
4. Re-upload the **same file** with `start_row = next_start_row` until `done=true`

## Chunking (required for large files)
| Field | Default | Purpose |
|-------|---------|--------|
| `start_row` | `3` | First Excel row number to process |
| `limit` | `25` | Max data rows per request (keep ≤25 under ~30s gateway) |

Each chunk validates rows, allocates global IDs once, then `insert_batch` for `item`, `item_conversion`, `branch_item`, and `item_cost` on every physical DB.

## Column guide (row 2 headers)
| Col | Header | API field / rule |
|-----|--------|------------------|
| A | Item Code | Reference only (error context) |
| B | Type | `type` — snake_case (`Goods` → `goods`) |
| C | Kinds of Goods | `kind` — comma-separated labels → snake_case |
| D | Name | `name` (required) |
| E | Brand | `brand`; default `-` if empty |
| F | For Canvassing | `is_canvassing` (`Yes`→`1`, `No`→`0`) |
| G | Item Description | `description` |
| H | Min. | `conversions[*][min]` |
| I | Max | `conversions[*][max]` |
| J | COST PRICE | `cost` |
| K | VAT TYPE | `vat_type` — snake_case, strip trailing `.` (`VAT In.` → `vat_in`) |
| L | VAT Account | Lookup `account_type.name` → `vat_account_type_id` |
| M | Account Type | Lookup `account_type.name` → `account_type_id` |
| N–S | Purchase/Clinic/Usage qty + units | `conversions[0..2]` |

## Multi-branch DB mirroring
Same rows written to: master (0), mobile (1), oakridge (2), mactan (3), consolacion (4), mantlewood (7), pharmacy (6). Transfer tables stay on master only.

## Dependency
Requires `phpoffice/phpspreadsheet` (`composer require phpoffice/phpspreadsheet:^1.29`).

## Consistency check
`GET /items/check_consistency` compares `item` rows on master vs each diagnostic DB (missing/extra ids + field diffs). Optional `is_deleted=0|all`.

## Duplicate cleanup
After accidental re-uploads, run `POST /items/cleanup_duplicate_items` to soft-delete extras sharing `(name, description, is_deleted=0)`, keeping `MIN(id)`. Cascades to child tables on master + all diagnostic DBs.

### SQL to inspect duplicates (master)
```sql
SELECT i.name, i.description, i.is_deleted, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(i.id ORDER BY i.id) AS item_ids, MIN(i.id) AS keep_item_id
FROM item i
WHERE i.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.name, i.description, i.is_deleted
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC, i.name;
```

## Save / Send
- Upload: Body → form-data → `file` type **File**; do **not** set `Content-Type` manually

## Fix consistency
1. Loop `POST /items/cleanup_duplicate_items` (`limit=25`) until `done`
2. Loop `POST /items/fix_consistency` (`limit=25`) until `done`
3. `GET /items/check_consistency` to verify

request.description:
## GET `/items/download_inventory_template`

Streams `inventory_list_template.xlsx` with columns A–S matching the INVENTORY LIST encoder layout.

### Success
Binary body with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="inventory_list_template.xlsx"`.

In Postman: **Send and Download** / Save Response as `.xlsx`.

request.description:
## POST `/items/upload_inventory`

Processes a **chunk** of Excel rows with batched multi-DB inserts.

### Body (multipart form-data)
| Field | Type | Required | Default |
|-------|------|----------|--------|
| `file` | file (`.xlsx` / `.xls`) | yes | — |
| `token` | text | yes | — |
| `requester` | text | yes | — |
| `start_row` | text | no | `3` |
| `limit` | text | no | `25` |

Do **not** set `Content-Type` manually.

### How to finish a full workbook
1. Call with `start_row=3`, `limit=25`
2. Read `next_start_row` from the response
3. Call again with the same file and `start_row={{next_start_row}}`
4. Repeat until `done=true` (`next_start_row` is null)

### Success response (more chunks remain)
```json
{
  "total_rows": 537,
  "processed_rows": 25,
  "success_count": 25,
  "failed_count": 0,
  "created": [{ "row": 3, "item_id": 101, "name": "Mouse" }],
  "errors": [],
  "next_start_row": 28,
  "done": false
}
```

### Final chunk
```json
{
  "total_rows": 537,
  "processed_rows": 12,
  "success_count": 12,
  "failed_count": 0,
  "created": [...],
  "errors": [],
  "next_start_row": null,
  "done": true
}
```

request.description:
## POST `/items/cleanup_duplicate_items`

Soft-deletes duplicate active items sharing `(name, description, is_deleted=0)`, keeping `MIN(id)`. Cascades to child tables on master + diagnostic DBs.

### Chunking
| Field | Default | Purpose |
|-------|---------|--------|
| `limit` | `25` | Max **item ids** soft-deleted per call |

Re-call until `done=true` / message `all databases rows is consistent`.

### Success (more remain)
```json
{
  "groups_cleaned": 5,
  "deleted_count": 25,
  "deleted": [...],
  "remaining_delete_count": 40,
  "done": false,
  "message": "Processed 25 duplicate item(s). Call again until done."
}
```

### Done
```json
{
  "groups_cleaned": 0,
  "deleted_count": 0,
  "deleted": [],
  "remaining_delete_count": 0,
  "done": true,
  "message": "all databases rows is consistent"
}
```

response.name: Chunk processed

request.description:
## GET `/items/check_consistency`

Compares `item` rows between **master** and each diagnostic DB (`mobile`, `oakridge`, `mactan`, `consolacion`, `mantlewood`, `pharmacy`).

### Query params
| Param | Default | Purpose |
|-------|---------|--------|
| `token` | required | Auth |
| `requester` | required | Auth |
| `is_deleted` | `0` | `0` active only; `all` include soft-deleted |

### Checks per DB
- `missing_on_branch` — ids on master not on branch
- `extra_on_branch` — ids on branch not on master
- `field_diffs` — same id, different columns (`name`, `description`, `is_deleted`, `type`, `kind`, `cost`, `brand`, `vat_type`, `account_type_id`, `vat_account_type_id`)

### Status
- SUCCESS when `consistent=true`
- FAIL when any DB has diffs (full report still returned)

Also works as POST with form-data.

request.description:
## POST `/items/fix_consistency`

Repairs `item` row inconsistencies between master and diagnostic DBs (chunks of `limit`, default 25).

### Rules (chunk order)
1. **Soft-delete (2.1)** — master `is_deleted=0` and **any** diagnostic has `is_deleted=1` for the same id → soft-delete on **all** DBs (cascade to child tables).
2. **Insert from diagnostic (2.2)** — diagnostic has an item id missing on master → `INSERT` that row onto master and any other DBs missing it (same explicit id).
3. **Push from master (2.3)** — master has an item id missing on any diagnostic → `INSERT` from master onto every DB missing that id.

**Item row only** (no child tables). **Field diffs are not auto-fixed** (except `is_deleted` via 2.1).

### Suggested order
1. Loop `cleanup_duplicate_items` until `done`
2. Loop `fix_consistency` until `done`
3. `check_consistency` to verify (remaining issues are usually `field_diffs`)

### Done messages
- `all databases rows is consistent` — only when an active-row `check_consistency`-equivalent compare would pass (no missing/extra/field_diffs).
- `No more supported consistency fixes remaining. Run check_consistency for remaining field_diffs.` — supported fixes exhausted; see `unsupported_field_diff_count` (and optional `remaining_missing_count` / `remaining_extra_count`).

response.name: Chunk processed
response.body:
{
  "fixed_count": 25,
  "soft_deleted": [{ "id": 101, "name": "Toner" }],
  "inserted": [{ "id": 999, "name": "Orphan", "source_db": "mobile" }],
  "pushed": [{ "id": 50, "name": "Master only", "source_db": "master" }],
  "remaining_count": 12,
  "done": false,
  "message": "Processed 25 consistency fix(es). Call again until done."
}

response.name: Done — field diffs remain
response.body:
{
  "fixed_count": 0,
  "soft_deleted": [],
  "inserted": [],
  "pushed": [],
  "remaining_count": 0,
  "done": true,
  "message": "No more supported consistency fixes remaining. Run check_consistency for remaining field_diffs.",
  "unsupported_field_diff_count": 42,
  "remaining_missing_count": 0,
  "remaining_extra_count": 0
}
